{"metadata":{"description":"Role-based Codex / Claude Code / ACP subagent providers for the DeepSeek Harness — continuable children, durable session recovery, per-role product permissions, and delegation with a permission ceiling.","id":"gh:1333417632","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-plugin-product-subagents","slug":"shaokeyibb/dsh-plugin-product-subagents","topics":["acp","claude-code","codex","cursor","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Role-based Codex / Claude Code / ACP subagent providers for the DeepSeek Harness — continuable child"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ren, durable session recovery, per-role product permissions, and delegation with a permission ceilin"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"n, durable session recovery, per-role product permissions, and delegation with a permission ceiling."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-product-subagents"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Role-based **Codex / Claude Code / ACP** subagent providers for the DeepSeek
Harness. Turns external"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" agent CLIs into durable, continuable subagents with a
declarative role library, per-role product pe"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"rmissions, delegation with a
permission ceiling, and cross-platform process launching."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Continuable children** — one-shot sync or async continuable (control with
`send_message`, `list_"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"agents`, `interrupt_agent`; attach synchronously with
`product_wait`).
- **Session continuity** — a "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"child's remote product session survives idle
disposal and process restarts (durable registry + log m"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"arkers; claude/codex
resume by id, ACP reconnects).
- **Declarative roles** (`roles/*.json`) — `gene"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ral` (default), `code-review`,
`explore` (never delegates), `debug`. Delegation defaults ON; a role "},{"id":"p6s6","text":"can ban
it. Unknown roles fall back to `general`.
- **Two-layer permission model** — the relay model"},{"id":"p6s7","text":" is always a read-only
pipe; `permissionMode` (`readonly` / `default` / `full`) applies to the
remot"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"e product and is mapped to each product's own CLI flags.
- **Permission ceiling** — a child can neve"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"r spawn a descendant with more
permission than it has.
- **Any ACP agent** — add Cursor (`agent acp`"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"), CodeBuddy (`cbc --acp`),
Gemini (`gemini --acp`) and more via `config.providers`; no code needed."},{"id":"p6s11","text":"
- **Resource management** — idle disposal, configurable timeouts, concurrency
cap.
- **Cross-platfo"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"rm** — Windows `.cmd` shims, Windows-safe path escaping;
CI runs macOS / Ubuntu / Windows."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- A DeepSeek Harness deployment (web profile). Every installable
`@deepseek-ai/dsh` release from `0."},{"id":"p8s2","text":"0.1-rc.5` through the current `0.1.5-rc.1`
is verified — see Compatibility.
- At least one product C"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"LI on `PATH` and authenticated: `claude`, `codex`, or
an ACP CLI (`opencode`, `agent`, `cbc`, …).
- "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"H` and authenticated: `claude`, `codex`, or
an ACP CLI (`opencode`, `agent`, `cbc`, …).
- Node ≥ 18."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Recommended — `dsh plugin add`"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"That single command installs the package **and** wires the host-plane row
automatically: the plugin "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ships a `cordis.patch.yml` declared via
`dsh.bundle` in its `package.json`, so `dsh plugin add` regi"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"sters it as a
profile layer (no manual `cordis.patch.yml` editing needed). Restart the
harness after"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"wards so the plugin loads."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"To customise the plugin (e.g. add ACP providers), target the `product-subagents`
id in your profile'"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"s own `cordis.patch.yml` (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"> **Note:** a config override replaces the row's whole `config` object, so
> restate any keys you wi"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"sh to keep (like `idleTimeoutMs` above)."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Install via your agent (one line)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Paste this to your DeepSeek Harness agent (or any coding agent with shell
access to the harness home"},{"id":"p17s2","text":") — it performs every step itself:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"> Install the `dsh-plugin-product-subagents` plugin into my DeepSeek Harness
> web profile: run `dsh"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-product-subagents`,
> then tell me to restart the harness so th"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"le web add dsh-plugin-product-subagents`,
> then tell me to restart the harness so the plugin loads."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Manual (advanced)"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"If you prefer to manage the profile yourself, use pnpm (not npm) inside the
profile directory so pee"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"r dependencies are not auto-installed:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Then add a host-plane row to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"In a session, the model has six tools:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Tool | Purpose |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| `product_delegate` | delegate a task under a role (sync or continuable) |
| `product_roles` | list"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" the role library |
| `product_submit` | per-child bridge (continuable children only) |
| `subagent_"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"progress` | status + internal trace of one child |
| `product_wait` | block until a child settles, r"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"eturn its answer |
| `product_agents` | provider availability + live children |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"### Provider ids"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"`claude-code`, `codex`, `acp` (and any `config.providers` key) stay the names
you use in roles and i"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"n `product_delegate` — but they are also the ids the
official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-claude-code"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"` / `-codex` / `-acp` plugins
register under, and the harness rejects a duplicate provider id hard e"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"nough to
fail the whole profile's plugin tree at boot."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"So on `ctx.subagents` this plugin registers namespaced, plugin-owned ids —
`product-subagents:claude"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"-code` and friends — and both plugins can live in one
profile. This only changes the harness-wide `s"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"ubagent` tool's provider names;
nothing in this plugin's own surface moved. Set `providerNamespace: "},{"id":"p33s4","text":"''` to
register the bare keys again (safe only where no official product subagent
plugin is loaded)."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"`package.json` declares the supported DSH range under `dsh.compatibility`, plus
`dshReleases` — a pe"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"r-release `compatible` / `incompatible` / `unknown` verdict.
Every `compatible` verdict is backed by"},{"id":"p35s3","text":" an acceptance run in a **disposable
profile**, not by the range alone:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"For one DSH release that creates a throwaway `$DSH_HOME`, installs the packed
tarball with the real "},{"id":"p37s2","text":"`dsh plugin add`, checks the composed profile tree, boots
the profile and asserts from inside the ru"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"nning harness that all six tools are
registered, the providers reached the real `SubagentRuntime`, a"},{"id":"p37s4","text":"nd the tools
execute and schema-validate — then uninstalls and checks the bundle layer is
gone. It n"},{"id":"p37s5","text":"eeds no API key, and it is not part of `npm test`."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"The recorded matrix and what a verdict does (and does not) prove are in
docs/COMPATIBILITY.md."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"This is a **configuration-as-trust-boundary** tool: it spawns whatever CLIs
you configure, and `full"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"` passes the products' own "bypass all permission
checks" flags. See SECURITY.md."}],"truncated":true}
